content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-191. - I.R.C. Section R501.3, Structural floors.
content.summary:
Section R501.3. Structural floors,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
R501.3. Structural floors.
When structural floors are required, they shall comply with sections R501.3.1 and
                  R501.3.2."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
